# The level of the AI strength (global flags). Normal when no flag is set.
DA_AI_level_none = {
	has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_none
}
DA_AI_level_easy = {
	has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_easy
}
DA_AI_level_normal = {
	OR = {
		has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_normal
		NOT = { OR = { has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_none has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_easy has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_hard has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_very_hard } }
	}
}
DA_AI_level_hard = {
	has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_hard
}
DA_AI_level_very_hard = {
	has_global_flag = DA_AI_level_very_hard
}

	any_country = {
		ai = no
